findings.finding: Q3 2026 award flow on NewsWeb was thin: only two contract notices in July-September (BMO NOK ~60m on 2 July, Nova Water Solutions NOK ~78m on 6 July) against about ten in Q2, when order intake was NOK 2.3bn, so Q3 order intake is likely well under revenue and the backlog likely falls from NOK 8.5bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 printed a 0.8x book-to-bill with record EBITA and the stock rose 3.1% over the window, so a seasonally soft intake quarter has been looked through before.
findings.why_not_priced: Each notice is public, but nobody adds them up, and most intake (frameworks, small jobs) is never announced, so the market has no Q3 intake number. If a backlog decline were priced, the stock would not have risen 10% in 20 days to near its high, and SEB and Danske would not have raised their targets in November.
findings.independence: The Q2 release shows how much announced awards drive intake (Trivium alone NOK 1.25bn of 2.3bn): https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=680246

findings.finding: The bar has been lifted into the print: Danske Bank raised its target from 130 to 140 (Buy) on 3 November and SEB from 117 to 130 (Hold) on 10 November, while the stock rose from 101.4 (16 Sept) to 129.4 (11 Nov), +10.2% over 20 days.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After Q2 (+2.5% on the day) Nordea and Danske cut targets and SEB had downgraded to Hold on 17 Aug; the stock then drifted down to 100.6 by 14 Sept.
findings.original_quote: Endúr SEB höjer riktkursen för Endúr till 130 norska kronor (117), upprepar behåll (SEB raises its target for Endúr to NOK 130 (117), reiterates hold); 3 Nov: 'Endúr Danske Bank höjer riktkursen för Endúr till 140 norska kronor (130), upprepar köp' (Danske raises to NOK 140 (130), reiterates buy) https://www.placera.se/telegram/dagens-aktierekommendationer-i-oversikt-20261103
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced in the sense that it raises expectations. The finding is that the print now has to clear a raised bar. The stock trades at SEB's new target and within 8% of the 140 high.
findings.independence: The marketscreener consensus page lists the same two raises: https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/END-R-ASA-55178918/consensus/

findings.finding: Insiders bought shortly before the quarter-end: Kverva Finans (board member Børge Klungerbo) bought 450,000 shares at NOK 109.28 on 25 Sept, the chairman bought 7,000 at NOK 101.34 on 16 Sept, and the company buyback runs weekly through the closed period (week 45 notice, 10 Nov).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None measurable; the stock has risen about 18% since the Kverva purchase.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced already, since the stock is up about 18% since 25 Sept. What is left is that a board-related holder put NOK ~49m in five days before Q3 closed. The buyback is a steady bid that does not stop for the report.

findings.finding: The baseline's zero short is a spelling miss: Finanstilsynet's register lists 'ENDÚR' (NO0012555459) with JPMorgan Asset Management (UK) short 0.51% since 2026-10-14. That is a small new position, not crowded fuel, and it has been losing since the stock rose about 10% after it was opened.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: no prior disclosed short on this name in the register
findings.why_not_priced: It is a public disclosure, but at 0.51% it is neither fuel for a squeeze nor an informed-seller signal of any weight. It is filed to correct the baseline, not as edge.

findings.finding: Land-based aquaculture counterparties are stretched: Salmon Evolution (Artec Aqua VAQ's phase 2 client) says construction finishes by year-end, with the last two tanks handed over in Q1 2027, and took a NOK 200m DNB facility 'following lower-than-expected salmon prices'; Endúr's own new aquaculture work in October is a pre-project for a bankruptcy estate (Gaia Salmon). The segment's backlog gap and Salfjord FID are the open questions.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The segment is about 16% of revenue and its outlook has been described as having a 'medium-term gap' since Q3 2025 without a visible reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Endúr's own guide has already flagged the gap, so this is mostly priced. Net of the rest of the company (about 84% infrastructure, growing) it is a small segment effect. It matters only if the release confirms no Salfjord FID and a falling aquaculture backlog.
findings.independence: Gaia Salmon bankruptcy-estate pre-project: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=683465; Salmon Evolution handover update 2026-11-11: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=686158

findings.finding: The Q4-to-date subsequent events are strong and will sit in the release: about NOK 0.4bn of awards and backlog additions in Oct-Nov (Marcon SEK ~100m, Totalbetong +NOK ~150m, BMO NOK ~66m, Engelsen Total NOK ~90m) plus two acquisitions (Notech EV NOK 120m at about 6x EBIT, adding NOK ~50m of backlog; F15 EV SEK 38.5m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Strong subsequent-event lists accompanied the Q4 2025 (+2.8%) and Q1 2026 (-0.8%) prints, a mixed record.
findings.why_not_priced: Each item was announced and is largely priced; the stock rose from 114 to 129 over these weeks. What it adds is a softer read on a weak Q3 backlog number, which limits the negative in finding 1 rather than adding new positive news.

findings.finding: Cash flow is the line the brokers marked down after Q2: H1 operating cash flow was NOK -37.3m and cash fell from 1,280m to 622m, which the company attributed to 'anticipated milestone effects on certain projects under start-up'; Q3 2025 delivered NOK 139m. Whether Q3 shows the unwind is unknown.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2: the stock rose 2.5% on the day despite weak cash, then Nordea and Danske cut targets within a week and the stock drifted to 100.6.
findings.why_not_priced: The direction is genuinely unknown: the company pre-flagged the milestone effects as anticipated, which argues for a Q3 unwind, but the M&A cash outflow continued. It is sized at 0 with a wide range.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is -0.51 (run-up only, since the register spelling was missed); the findings lean faintly negative too, so they agree with the run-up and add little beyond it.
language_note: The Swedish placera.se recommendation digests carried dated, broker-named target changes (Danske 130->140 on 3 Nov, SEB 117->130 on 10 Nov), which the English search snippets got wrong (one summary said Danske's latest action was the August cut).

Norwegian-language searches (Finansavisen, E24, DN, 'kursmål') returned nothing the English releases did not carry. Endúr publishes its NewsWeb releases in English only, so the filing half is not local at all.
lessons_applied: 'You were right about the number and too small about the move' and 'numbers not pre-released' moved abs_move_pct from 4.0 to 5.0 for new numbers on a $1.6m/day name. It stays below the 7% European base because no numeric guide exists to change, and the name's own 8 quarterly reactions have a median of 2.95% (max 6.07).
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' added a cash-flow finding, sized at 0 with a wide range, and listed cash_flow under new_in_release.
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' (already priced by an 18% rise) cut the insider-buying finding from +0.3 to +0.2 and the Q4-to-date order flow from +0.3 to +0.2.
'A narrow proxy loses' (counting announced awards is an inference about intake) cut the thin-Q3-awards finding from -0.6 to -0.5.
Run-up plus target raises moved p_up from 50 to 48. Expected move is (2*0.48-1)*5.0 = -0.2.
